turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sanibonani namukelekile kwi-module yemisindo lapho ozofunda ngemisindo efanele ukufundwa ebangeni ngalinye.
turns.en: Hello, welcome to the phonics module where you will learn about the sounds that should be taught in each grade.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: From Grade R to the third.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: I-module oqeda ukuyifunda ibikhuluma ngolwazi lwemisindo lapho olungiselela ukwethula umsindo omusha ngokuthi bawulalele, bawuzwe, bakwazi nokuhlukaniswa ngokubuzwa.
turns.en: The module you have just finished reading was talking about phonological awareness where you prepare to introduce a new sound by having them listen to it, hear it, and be able to distinguish it when asked.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: Now we will help the learners to hear, to see

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sizosiza abafundi ukuzwa, ukubona, ukuphimisa nokubhala imisindo.
turns.en: We will help the learners to hear, to see, to pronounce and to write the sounds.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emuva kokuqeda le-module uzokwazi ukuchaza ukuthi ulwazi lwemisindo lweseka kanjani amakhono emisindo.
turns.en: After completing this module you will be able to explain how phonological awareness supports phonics skills.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukuthi amakhono abaluleke kangakanani ekufundiseni izinhlamvu olimini lwesiZulu.
turns.en: How important the skills are in teaching letters in the isiZulu language.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: To teach the letters of the isiZulu language.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukubona isikhathi okumele usichithe uma ufundisa imisindo.
turns.en: To see the time you need to spend when you teach phonics.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ngithanda ukusebenzisa imidlalo ehlukene ukufundisa imisindo njengokucula ingoma yemisindo.
turns.en: I like to use different games to teach phonics such as singing a phonics song.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: Let's see how I do this.
